gloss_text: Someone pressed the front door bell. Do you want to watch the video or reply through the speaker?
There is a delivery worker at the gate who has pressed the bell twice. He is waiting for your confirmation.
Your expected visitor Noura has arrived at the gate. Do you want me to open the door for her?
A parcel arrived for flat 302 and is at reception. You can collect it before 6 pm.
The internet technician has arrived at reception for flat 5A and needs your approval through the app.
There is a visitor named Salem waiting in the lobby for flat 3C, and he says he is invited to dinner tonight. Do you want me to let him up?
Live captions are off. Tap to turn them on again.
The Arabic language pack has been downloaded. Captions will now work without an internet connection.
Live captions are paused temporarily during the video call.
The download of the language pack for live captions has finished.
Live captions: on-device processing has been turned on for this device.
The speech recognition model was updated. No action is needed.

Who is coming to the beach on Friday? I'll bring the ice cream 🍦, and my uncle said he'll bring the chairs. We meet at 11 in front of the bus stop, and no being late this time! Sara, can you bring the camera? We need photos for the Eid card.

Has anyone seen a grey striped cat near the square? It has a blue collar and is very calm. If you find it, please tell the lady in the fourth-floor flat. And for anyone looking for a plumber: the one at the end of the street has excellent work, I tried him yesterday.

Guys, the café next to the pitch opens at 9 am, so we need to agree on the shirts. I still have the red one, can someone bring the bibs? And Ahmed, stop saying you scored the final goal, the video is clear 😂
The Mario Kart tournament was really fun. Does anyone have the replay? We could play again Thursday night if anyone has time, I have a new move for the castle track you must try before next season.

I'm resending this message: good morning everyone, send this message to ten people to bring luck to your family this week. Whoever doesn't send it will suffer bad luck for a full month. I wish you all a happy day 🌞

Forwarded: there is a rumour that the canteen will close in January. Nobody has confirmed it and the school administration has issued no statement. Please do not spread it without a source, but if anyone has proof, tell us before tomorrow so we can check with the headmistress.

I'm forwarding the picture I got this morning: good morning, a little smile and a nice day! With a cup of coffee and flowers. Send it to your loved ones, it makes everyone happy. Thanks to all the neighbours.

Owners' meeting on Thursday at 7:30 pm in the events hall. Agenda: facade renovation, garden budget and choosing the new doorman. Please confirm attendance before Tuesday evening, there will be drinks and sweets for everyone.

For the street party we are collecting 15 riyals from each household for the barbecue and sound system. Transfer the money to Khalid before the 30th. The party is on 14 July from 4 pm in the square behind the school. Bring your chairs!

Reminder: the start-of-year meeting has been moved to Tuesday at 6 pm in room 12. On the agenda: the school trips plan and the organisation of the year-end fair. Bring ideas for stalls, we will discuss them over coffee.

Smoke has been reported on the third floor of Block B. The firefighters are on the way. Please leave through the emergency stairs in the courtyard, do not use the lift, and do not return to the building until management announces it. Stay calm.

A gas leak has been reported on Palm Street, with a strong smell. Do not turn on lights or a lighter, open the windows and leave the building now. Ambulance crews are on the way, move away from the street and wait for instructions.

Water is pooling on the Corniche road after heavy rain. Avoid the area, stay on the upper floors and follow the instructions of the competent authorities. The road is closed until further notice, do not cross on foot or by car.

There is a restaurant delivery worker at the gate who wants to bring the order to the second floor. He has been waiting five minutes and cannot stay long. Tell me whether you agree to leave it at reception, or should he come back?
Someone pressed the main door bell. On the video a man in a yellow vest is holding a parcel and waiting at the gate. You can reply from the app or leave a message, and he will leave after a minute.

A visitor named Abdullah is waiting at the building gate for flat 7 and says he is invited to a family gathering tonight. I cannot verify without your approval, so I asked him to wait in the corridor. Shall I let him in?
Your expected visitor, Umm Mohammed, has arrived at the gate and has been waiting for two minutes. Shall I tell her to come in, or tell her you will come down to meet her?
